description: This file contains shell commands for managing iptables rules related to rate limiting ICMP echo-request packets. It includes adding, verifying, and removing a specific iptables rule, primarily used for testing or configuring network rate limits.
calls: iptables -I INPUT 1 -p icmp --icmp-type echo-request -m limit --limit 1/second --limit-burst 3 -j ACCEPT
iptables -D INPUT -p icmp --icmp-type echo-request -m limit --limit 1/second --limit-burst 3 -j ACCEPT
